headlines.summary: 급등하는 월세에 무주택자들 신음 평균 금액 144만→166만원 상승 10%초반대 전세·매매 상승률 추월 ‘노도강’ 16%↑, 외곽 서민 ‘직격탄’ 임대료가 고공행진하는 가운데 지난 1년 동안 서울 아파트 평균 월세가 전세가 오르는 폭보다 가파르게 상승한 것으로 집계됐다.

headlines.title: “ 수도권 7만6700호 공급위해선 토지보상·교통망구축 시급 ”
headlines.summary: ■ ‘10·29 공급대책’ 전문가 제언 “합의 등 지연땐 3기 신도시 꼴” “지하철 등 해결돼야 공급 신뢰” 정부가 경기지역에 신규 공공택지 7만6700호를 공급하고 2030년까지 착공하겠다고 발표했지만, 전문가들은 3기 신도시 토지보상·광역교통망 구축 지연이 되풀이될 수 있다는 우려 섞인 전망을 내놓고 있다.

headlines.title: 가격 오른 배추, 재배면적 증가 … 내림세 무는 감소

headlines.title: 올해 가을배추 재배면적 5.5% 증가 … 가을무는 1.3% 감소
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 국가데이터처, 2026년 가을배추·무 재배면적조사 결과 연도별 가을배추·무 재배면적 추이(2006~2026). 국가데이터처 제공 올해 가을배추 재배면적은 지난해보다 증가한 반면 가을무는 소폭 감소한 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 法 없어 안방 내준 ‘ K-코인결제 ’

headlines.title: 한은 “ 해외 코인카드, 과세 회피 악용 우려 ”
headlines.summary: 해외 발급 이용 현황조차 파악 못해 자료 제출 요구할 법적 근거도 미비 “해외사업자 감독 근거 마련해야” 한국은행이 해외 발급 크립토카드에 대해 자금 이동과 과세 규제 회피 수단이 될 수 있다고 국회에 보고한 것으로 확인됐다. 해외 사업자에 관련 자료를 요구하는 데에도 제도적 한계가 있어 발급·이용 현황조차 파악하지 못하고 있다는 한계도 지적됐다.

headlines.title: 결제 ‘ T+1 ’ 전환, 빨라도 늦어도 ‘ 독 ’

key_headlines.title: Seoul Monthly Rent Surges 15% Year-over-Year as Jeonse Market Collapses
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment monthly rent jumped from 1.44 million to 1.66 million won over the past year, outpacing the rise in jeonse and purchase prices. The shift reflects a fundamental market transformation as landlords unable to secure loans increasingly convert to monthly rent arrangements.

key_headlines.title: National Tax Revenue Increases 95 Trillion Won Through September on Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: Cumulative national tax revenue through September reached 385 trillion won, up 33% year-over-year, with corporate tax rising by 52 trillion won driven by improved semiconductor company earnings. The progress rate reached 80.5% of the revised estimate.

key_headlines.title: Industrial Production Records Largest Gain in 15.5 Years Amid Semiconductor and Auto Boom
key_headlines.summary: September industrial production increased 3.0% month-over-month, the highest since March 2011, driven by surging semiconductor demand and explosive recovery in automotive manufacturing post-strike. Consumption and investment also grew simultaneously, marking a 'triple increase' in three months.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Trading Volume Halves Year-over-Year as Market Faces Trading Cliff
key_headlines.summary: September apartment transactions in Seoul fell to 3,915 cases, down 42.4% from 6,796 cases last year, as loan restrictions, land transaction permit zones, and rising mortgage rates create a trading cliff situation.

key_headlines.title: Jeonse Market Terminates as Monthly Rent Share Reaches 69.7% Nationally
key_headlines.summary: National monthly rent transactions (including deposit-backed rent) accounted for 69.7% of rental deals in September, up from traditional jeonse which fell to 25.7%, marking an accelerated end to the jeonse era as landlords face financing constraints.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's real estate market is experiencing a dramatic structural shift driven by the collapse of the jeonse system. Monthly rent has surged 15% year-over-year in Seoul while traditional jeonse transactions plummet, as landlords unable to secure loans increasingly convert to monthly rental arrangements. Apartment trading volumes have halved due to strengthened loan regulations and rising mortgage rates, creating a 'trading cliff' situation. The supply of new apartments continues to dwindle, with 2026 Seoul apartment completions projected at the lowest level in 13 years at 17,698 units. This convergence of factors is creating severe housing affordability challenges for non-property owners.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's fiscal position has strengthened significantly with national tax revenue through September reaching 385 trillion won, a 33% increase year-over-year, buoyed primarily by semiconductor company profits generating 52 trillion won in additional corporate tax. The employment rate in the working-age population (15-64) reached 70.6% in September while unemployment remained low at 2.0%, supporting arguments for potential rate increases to address financial stability concerns including rising property prices and household debt. The Bank of Korea is watching global monetary policy developments closely, particularly as the U.S. Federal Reserve maintained its pause on rate hikes despite strong GDP growth of 3.4% and persistent inflation concerns. Currency volatility and elevated won-dollar exchange rates continue to present policy challenges from a financial stability perspective.
sections.Financial Markets: Korean stock markets experienced severe volatility and significant declines following weakness in U.S. technology stocks, particularly Alphabet's disappointing earnings report. The KOSPI fell sharply by 3-5% during intraday trading, triggering sell-side circuit breakers for the 28th time this year, with semiconductor heavyweights Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix among the hardest hit. Reflecting broader market turmoil, domestic fund market net assets declined 87.8 trillion won in the third quarter to 1,646.7 trillion won, marking the first quarterly decrease in over four years as stock-focused funds suffered significant valuation losses from the KOSPI's nearly 20% plunge. Investor sentiment remains cautious ahead of the U.S. presidential election and amid uncertainty over future Fed policy direction.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea is positioning itself as Germany's optimal strategic partner for supply chain diversification across semiconductors, batteries, and AI-driven manufacturing transformation (AX). Prime Minister Han Sung-sook emphasized at the Asia-Pacific Germany Business Conference that Korea offers trusted, cross-border collaboration opportunities as geopolitical tensions and trade protectionism escalate. September industrial production surged 3.0% month-over-month, the largest increase in 15.5 years, driven by robust semiconductor demand and explosive automotive production recovery following labor disruptions. The government is strengthening cooperation frameworks with Germany on critical mineral supply chain resilience and advanced technology partnerships.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's real estate market faces a severe supply crisis with new apartment completions projected at 17,698 units for 2026, the lowest level in 13 years, down 45% from 2025 and representing only one-third of 2019's 46,118 units. Monthly rent for Seoul apartments has surged 15% year-over-year, reaching an average of 1.66 million won, reflecting the structural collapse of the jeonse system as landlords increasingly resort to monthly rental arrangements due to financing constraints. September apartment transactions plummeted 42.4% year-over-year to 3,915 cases due to intensified loan regulations, land transaction permit zones, and sharply rising mortgage rates creating a trading cliff situation. The shrinking supply of new apartments amid rising rental costs is pushing housing affordability barriers higher for prospective buyers.
sections.International Economy: U.S. economic growth remained robust with third-quarter GDP expanding 3.4% annualized, exceeding market expectations, though U.S. government debt relative to GDP has reached 100% of GDP for the first time in 80 years. The Federal Reserve maintained its policy rate at 3.75-4.00% despite strong growth and elevated inflation, signaling a pause in its tightening cycle while noting reduced necessity for frequent policy reviews. Fed Chair Kevin Powell expressed particular attention to Korean economic developments, emphasizing Korea's importance as a supplier of advanced technology products amid ongoing geopolitical competition. Alphabet's disappointing earnings results have reignited concerns about artificial intelligence investment profitability, triggering broader technology sector selloffs that ripple through global markets.
sections.AI & Economy: Major U.S. technology companies face mounting investor concerns about artificial intelligence infrastructure investment profitability as both Alphabet and Amazon reported disappointing third-quarter earnings despite significant AI cloud revenue growth. Amazon's third-quarter revenue of 201.94 billion dollars fell short of 202.31 billion dollar market expectations, while massive capital expenditures on data centers and semiconductors are deteriorating cash flows and raising questions about AI venture viability. Samsung SDS and LG CNS are accelerating AI transformation and robotics commercialization after confirming strong third-quarter AI and cloud demand, with LG CNS recording 15% year-over-year operating profit growth of 138.2 billion won. Morgan Stanley analysts indicate Korean exports to the United States now serve as a leading indicator for gauging U.S. artificial intelligence infrastructure investment flows.
sections.Others: Hyundai Motor Company reported quarter-on-quarter revenue decline for the first time in seven years amid labor strike impacts and slowing sales, though year-over-year results improved due to semiconductor tailwinds and cost optimization efforts offsetting approximately 500 billion won in raw material cost increases. The World Bank managing director emphasized that sustainable growth generation, particularly through AI and power infrastructure development, should be prioritized over debt repayment, especially for countries like Korea experiencing excess tax revenues from semiconductor booms. Donghuk Steel recorded third-quarter operating profit of 29.9 billion won, up 22% year-over-year, as the company expanded structural steel production for semiconductor factories and AI data center mega-projects despite seasonal profitability headwinds.
